business_problem: Planted is a young company that combines proprietary structuring and fermentation technologies to produce meat from plant proteins, focusing on delicious taste, meaty and juicy texture, while only using natural ingredients. Founded in July 2019 as a spin-off from ETH Zurich, the Swiss company now employs more than 200 people in Switzerland and several other countries (including Germany, Austria, Italy, France, UK and BeNeLux). Its meats targeting flexitarians can be found in various supermarkets as well as restaurants across Europe. The main production facility is located in Planted‘s Headquarter in Kemptthal near Zurich.
solution_summary: Planted used Power Automate, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics 365 Business Central to move core workloads and data onto a modern cloud platform.
